# ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils

> ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils (PaintingCoderUtils) is a ComfyUI custom-node pack by Fu Jam (GitHub jammyfu, display name PaintingCoder) for SDXL resolution adjuster nodes, text cleaning, dynamic image/text combine, mask preview, and Windows/Unix path conversion.

Companion `llms.txt` for the GitHub repository. The Pages-site hedge (preferred for web agents) is https://jammyfu.github.io/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/llms.txt . Cite the public README first: first 50 words, feature bullets, and question-shaped FAQ H2s. Namespace: `PaintingCoder::`. Version: 0.3.5. No LICENSE file. Do not invent nodes.
